main_full_gate_contract: Only currentMain displayed data/missing/category rows+approvedinsurancefootnote are required. CSV-only redundant fields cannotfailMain gate. Original SQLanddocumentedrichprimaryaugmentationarevalid source-lineage;reproduceOLD beforeNEW with identicalsource perrow.

known_source_branch_checks.weight: Original05SQL uses latest weight_durations prior to t0; OLD displayed row reproduces from raw.weight_kg. first_day_weight is a distinct source and is not substituted.
known_source_branch_checks.sofa_t0: raw.sofa_baselineend<=t0 vs legacykeysofa_t0(starttime<=t0+1h). Compare actualOLD; currentrepairpre-t0descriptor must beexplicit andconsistentwithauthorizedmodeldefinition,not change onlylabel.
known_source_branch_checks.gcs: raw.gcs_baselineprior6h vs firstdaygcs_min; labelminimumsupportsdocumentedfirstday source;explicit OLDgate.
known_source_branch_checks.NEE: Approvedsixhourmean alreadydocumented; usecorrectedaugmentation(avg overlappingvaso),not originalrawlastNEE or zerofill undocumentedalternative.

unknown_items: MAP and arterial BG actual original overall generator remain NOT_REPRODUCED. Correct registered baseline mappings for creatinine/lactate/UO and saved firstphys path flags are explicit source definitions. No albumin/biliMain blocker.
